mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, type, title, body_format, content_version, owner_user_id, last_opened_at, storage_file_id, size_bytes, lifecycle, deleted_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.size_bytes), 0) FROM doc_object o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.type = 'FILE' AND o.lifecycle = 'ACTIVE' AND o.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
